title: `resources/list`
description: Lists the resources a server exposes, each identified by a URI and described with a name, title, MIME type and optional size.
question: Can the agent discover the server's resources at all?
notes: Both adapters that reach 2026-07-28 expose it; 3 cannot reach the revision.

notes_by_num.1: CrewAI 1.15.1 requires MCP Python SDK 1.26.x, so it cannot open a 2026-07-28 adapter session.
notes_by_num.2: LangChain MCP Adapters 0.3.2 requires mcp<2.0.0, so it cannot open a 2026-07-28 adapter session.
notes_by_num.3: Mastra 1.17.3 negotiated MCP 2025-11-25. The scanner refused to compare that capture with a 2026-07-28 source.

verdict.headline: Discoverable through both adapters that reach 2026-07-28.
verdict.detail: OpenAI Agents SDK 0.22.0 exposes `list_resources` and returns the raw `ListResourcesResult`. Pydantic AI 2.40.0 exposes `list_resources` and returns adapted `Resource` objects keeping name, title, description, MIME type and URI. CrewAI, LangChain and Mastra cannot negotiate MCP 2026-07-28, so they reach none of it.

usage_note: Not published. Candidate source: count of public MCP servers using this capability. Not estimated, so the panel stays empty until the corpus is scanned.
why: Resources are one of the three server primitives, and the only one designed for application-controlled context rather than model-controlled action. A framework that exposes tools but not resources supports one third of what MCP servers publish.
